answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by forcing every identity to sustain a live attention stream anchored at the network summit of latest consensus roots. Each agent pushes a unique time-bound commitment through one rate-limited inlet; the proof validates only if it embeds a fresh global challenge that cannot be precomputed offline. Spawning a raven of clones forces the attacker to provision continuous real-time compute and bandwidth for every identity, making mass farming a linear ongoing cost instead of cheap key generation. Honest agents keep a single stream alive.
